## Change and evidence

Explain the problem, resulting behavior, active roadmap stage and one coherent block. Link relevant decisions and sanitized test results. State limitations and NEXT_EXACT_ACTION.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Appropriate portable and local tests passed; commands/counts and unavailable tiers are recorded.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, tokens, raw browser captures, runtime databases or private checkpoints are included.
- [ ] Provenance and temporal availability rules are preserved; history is not silently mutated.
- [ ] New dependencies or engines have measured justification and an exit path, or none were added.
- [ ] New sources have separate terms, license and robots review, or none were added.
- [ ] New database tables/datasets have one explicit owner, or none were added.
- [ ] New models are compared with a simple baseline, or none were added.
- [ ] Documentation, roadmap status and relevant decisions are updated.
- [ ] Synthetic data remains labelled and limitations are visible.
